correctness.rationale: In repairs/2/RESULT.md the two positive uniform equilibria are enumerated and all stability/bifurcation claims are explicitly scoped to (1,1). The negative trace and determinant 1-(r-3)z+rz² give all stability and zero-mode regimes, including double-root r=9 and overlapping endpoints. At an isolated r>9 threshold the right/left modal null vectors (1,h),(4,-h) give transversality -λh[2rz-(r-3)]≠0. The simple-eigenvalue theorem gives the branch in real states. Exact polynomial expansion and zero Laplacian column sums give the two linear equations for mean shifts; their inverse yields (5). Inserting the tangent yields deficits h(7-3h), h(8-3h) times σ²s² with positive coefficients. The simple path spectrum, z+/z-→1 and a strict gap-ratio bound give n-1 bands, with P₂ and the rational P₃ example consistent. The repaired record asserts neither patterned stability nor a global mean sign.
residual_risks: Local branches only at isolated simple thresholds with r>9; no patterned-branch attraction is established.
